mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no),0)+1 FROM knowledge_document_version WHERE document_id=#{documentId}
SELECT FROM knowledge_document_version v JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id=v.document_id WHERE v.document_id=#{documentId} AND v.version_no=#{versionNo}
SELECT FROM knowledge_document_version v JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id=v.document_id WHERE v.id=#{id}

SELECT d.public_id,d.title,d.document_type,d.product_id,d.active_version_id, (SELECT v.id FROM knowledge_document_version v WHERE v.document_id=d.id ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1) latest_version_id, (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM knowledge_document_version v WHERE v.document_id=d.id) latest_version, (SELECT v.status FROM knowledge_document_version v WHERE v.document_id=d.id ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1) latest_status, (SELECT v.error_message FROM knowledge_document_version v WHERE v.document_id=d.id ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1) error_message, d.created_at FROM knowledge_document d ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document_version SET status='PROCESSING',error_message=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE knowledge_document_version SET status='FAILED',error_message=#{message} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE knowledge_document_version SET status='PENDING',error_message=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED'
UPDATE knowledge_document_version SET status='READY',error_message=NULL WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE knowledge_document SET active_version_id=#{versionId} WHERE id=#{documentId}
mapper.select: SELECT active_version_id FROM knowledge_document WHERE document_type=#{documentType} AND active_version_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_ingest_outbox(document_version_id,event_type,payload_json,status,attempts,next_attempt_at,last_error,published_at) VALUES(#{versionId},'KNOWLEDGE_VERSION_CREATED',CAST(#{payloadJson} AS JSON),'PENDING',0,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),NULL,NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload_json=VALUES(payload_json),status='PENDING',attempts=0, next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),last_error=NULL,published_at=NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id,document_version_id,payload_json,attempts,created_at FROM knowledge_ingest_outbox WHERE status='PENDING' AND attempts < 5 AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_ingest_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE knowledge_ingest_outbox SET attempts=attempts+1,last_error=#{message},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_ingest_outbox WHERE status='PENDING'
